Subject: Demo synthesis + trial proposal — Clinicaid evaluation plan

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. I captured a compact plan below to keep momentum and align on what success looks like for Clinicaid's trial. Please review and flag anything you want adjusted; if this looks good we'll lock the kickoff date and get the trial resources scheduled.

Goal: Validate that Redwood Inference can reliably surface structured triage recommendations from Clinicaid EHR notes at <= 150ms median generation latency and with hit-rate >= 80% on the agreed test set.

Proposed trial scope (4-week evaluation):
- Week 0 (prep, 1 week): data handoff, access, security questionnaire completion, mapping of 2 canonical workflows (admit triage, medication reconciliation).
- Week 1–2 (integration sprint, 2 weeks): deploy trial model to a dedicated pool, run ingestion pipeline on a 10k-record sample, iterate prompts and mappings.
- Week 3 (evaluation, 1 week): run blind evaluation on holdout set, measure accuracy/hit-rate, latency, and operational metrics.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: structured triage suggestions match clinician labeling with >= 80% precision (on the holdout set).
- Performance: median generation latency < 150ms for 95% of requests during evaluation load.
- Operational: model endpoint stable with < 3% error rate; logs and KV/cache behave within expected memory thresholds.
- Business: first-pass triage reduces manual triage time by >= 25% (measured by sampling).

Roles and ownership:
- Clinicaid: provide de-identified sample dataset (10k records) by Nov 13; provide clinical SME for label review and weekly syncs (1hr/week).
- Redwood: Solutions Engineer (Marissa) will lead integration, Ben will own infra/instance provisioning and security artifacts, I will be the engagement lead and exec point-of-contact.

Attachments & artifacts provided: POC outline (attached), SOC2 summary (attached), Drive folder with config templates (link below).

Kickoff proposal: Wednesday, Nov 16 — 30–45 minute kickoff to agree on data transfer mechanics and schedule the cadence. Can you confirm availability?

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm you can provide the de-identified sample by Nov 13.
2) Confirm the success criteria above — especially the 80% precision threshold and the 25% triage time reduction target.
3) Any additional security requirements we should surface early (VPN, IP allowlist, on-prem requirement).

Thanks — happy to shorten/expand any part of the plan.

Best,

2) Measurement: the 80% precision target sounds reasonable, but can we add a second metric for clinician adoption — e.g., fraction of suggestions accepted by clinicians during the evaluation (we were thinking >= 35%).
3) Timeline: Nov 13 dataset delivery is feasible if we get a quick SFTP or secure upload workflow.

Hi Maya — quick answers to your security and deployment questions:

- Dedicated: yes, our Dedicated offering provides isolated GPU pools within a tenant boundary, support for KMS-managed keys, and network controls (IP allowlist + private peering options). It satisfies the vast majority of enterprise security requirements and is what we recommend for clinical data.
- On-prem: we can discuss an on-prem package but that will add lead time (installation & validation) which may push the kickoff by several weeks. Recommend Dedicated for the trial to keep velocity.
- SOC2 / artifacts: attaching a SOC2 summary and a short FAQ for the security team. If Clinicaid requires full SOC2 report or penetration test evidence, we'll coordinate with Security immediately.

Operational notes and resourcing:
- Marissa will be your Solutions Engineer for this engagement — she will lead the connector work and prompt integration.
- I can commit to having the Dedicated pool provisioned and initial access configured by Nov 15 if we get confirmation to proceed this week.

Proposed calendar:
- Wed Nov 11: 30-min security sync with Clinicaid IT (Ben + security SME) to answer the attached questions.
- Tue Nov 15: infra ready; Wed Nov 16: kickoff and data handoff.

Please let me know preferred windows for the security sync (we're flexible 10:00–16:00 EST).
